compilation.basis: 1f_view.png: x/y anchors from outer wall faces matched to overall 15000x8000mm dimension lines (top and left chains). Partition centerlines measured from paired wall-line pixel profiles (rooms1-3 north row x~888/1353, rooms4-6 south row same x). Corridor is the open band between pixel y=600 and y=800 (north/south interior walls), spanning full building width, with door openings to each of the 6 perimeter rooms plus the west exterior main entrance. Window/door pixel spans measured directly from cyan opening ink and arc endpoints in the original drawing.

compilation.basis: 2f_view.png: x/y anchors from outer wall faces matched to overall 15000x8000mm dimension lines (top and left chains), same method as 1f_view.png. Partition centerlines measured from paired wall-line pixel profiles. Corridor is the open band between the measured interior wall lines at pixel y~609 (north) and y~794 (south), spanning full building width, with a door pair clustered at each of the top-room and bottom-room partitions and corridor-level windows on the west and east end walls.
